parameters.content:
env (SSM/Secrets→n8n env)
- N8N_REALM (default: default)
- GitLab:
  - N8N_GITLAB_BASE_URL / GITLAB_BASE_URL
  - N8N_GITLAB_API_BASE_URL / GITLAB_API_BASE_URL (default: <base>/api/v4)
  - N8N_GITLAB_TOKEN / GITLAB_TOKEN / GITLAB_ADMIN_TOKEN
  - N8N_GITLAB_PROJECT_ID or N8N_GITLAB_PROJECT_PATH (default: <realm>/technical-management)
  - N8N_GITLAB_ENVIRONMENT (default: production)
  - N8N_GITLAB_DEPLOYMENTS_MAX_PAGES (default: 20)
- S3:
  - N8N_S3_BUCKET (required)
  - N8N_S3_PREFIX (default: itsm/technical_management)
- Control (optional):
  - N8N_METRICS_TARGET_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD) / body.target_date

aiops_catalog.summary: GitLab DORA指標を日次集計してS3/Athenaへ連携する
